garhwali_benchmark_report.quality_policy: All records are active for experimental evaluation; schema, overlap, and quality signals remain explicit.

indicbertv2_masked_lm_report.scope: deterministic held-out pilot; masked positions selected by record hash

long_form_audio_report.reason: active local experimental audio; creator copyright blocks public redistribution

raw_data_policy: raw downloads and caches remain gitignored

retrieval_floor_report.metric_note: Recall and reciprocal rank treat the row-associated deduplicated context as relevant.
retrieval_floor_report.training_use: none; train-labelled queries are indexed as passages but not evaluated

sravaani_audio_grounded_review_report.evidence_limit: Waveform energy is not speech or language ground truth, raw model scores are weak review-ranking signals, and no target has a human reference.

sravaani_confidence_integration_report.data_grain: one row per original SraVaani source recording row

external_requirements.hardware: CUDA-capable NVIDIA GPU; 16 GB VRAM recommended
external_requirements.runtime: NVIDIA NeMo ASR with matching CUDA extra

sravaani_recovery_adjudication_report.evidence_limit: The two Whisper checkpoints are related, no target record has a human reference, and the shared calibration set contains no SraVaani output with this failure pattern. Proposals improve reviewability, not proven accuracy.

policy.accuracy: A source language label or open license is not evidence of native orthographic, semantic, or transcription accuracy.
policy.blocked_only_text: Text with no publishable provenance remains rights-pending; its identity and source evidence remain present in the public catalog.
policy.exact_duplicate_rights: An exact-unique text is publishable when at least one retained provenance record supplies compatible redistribution evidence. Blocked mirror provenance remains attached and does not revoke the open source grant.

translation_floor_report.metric_note: BLEU uses add-one smoothing; chrF uses character orders 1-6 and beta=2.
